properties.name: type
properties.description: 可通过type设置AddButton样式，实现样式的快速配置

properties.name: text
properties.description: 传入按钮文案, 不传时只展示Icon

properties.name: customTips
properties.description: 支持添加按钮后的 自定义文案tips

properties.name: popoverContent
properties.description: popover展示的内容 优先级高于透传arcoPopoverProps的content属性

properties.name: arcoPopoverProps
properties.description: 透传给 arco popover 的props

properties.name: dropdownList
properties.description: 下拉框的展示内容 优先级高于透传arcoDropdownProps的droplist属性

properties.name: arcoDropdownProps
properties.description: 透传给 arco dropdown 的props

properties.name: htmlType
properties.description: 按钮原生的 html type 类型, 默认值button

properties.name: inputMode
properties.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

properties.name: is
properties.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

doclets.name: CAddButtonType
doclets.type:
/**
 * 添加按钮类型
 * primary：基本/首要样式，包括蓝色的icon和文案
 * secondary: 次要样式，黑色文案和icon
 * dash：虚线边框，文案居中，Button宽度随父组件宽度变化而变化
 * */
export type CAddButtonType = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'dashed';
